# Tests (rebuild policy)

- Write the failing test first and watch it fail for the right reason.
- Assert observable behaviour, not implementation; one behaviour per test, named after it.
- Never commit `.only`, `.skip`, `xit`, a retried or a flaky test to get green. Fix it or report it.
- Never weaken an assertion or delete a test to make it pass; that needs the user's explicit OK.
- Use real code over mocks where it is cheap; mock only at system boundaries (network, clock, randomness).
- While building, run the tests that cover what you touched (the `test` command from `.rebuild/commands.json`, narrowed to those files or packages). The full cumulative suite runs once per slice, at the joint run, and not because you were unsure.
- A criterion with a `rule_id` has a test that asserts that Rule Card's exact values.
